package windivert

import "errors"

// Offline native boundary only. Its methods never claim native execution.
// Each successful/failed result is supplied by the test, not by default.
type Handle struct {
 RecvFunc func([]byte) (int, Address, error)
 RecvBatchFunc func([]byte) (int, []Address, error)
 RecvBatchIntoFunc func([]byte, []Address) (int, []Address, error)
 RecvBatchViewFunc func(int, func([]byte, []Address)) (int, error)
 RecvBatchViewForwardFunc func(int, func([]byte, []Address, func() (int, error))) (int, error)
 SendFunc func([]byte, *Address) (int, error)
 SendBatchFunc func([]byte, []Address) (int, error)
 ShutdownFunc func() error
 CloseFunc func() error
 DoneChan <-chan struct{}
}
var ReplayOpen func(*Filter, Layer, int16, Flag) (*Handle, error)
func Open(f *Filter,l Layer,p int16,flags Flag)(*Handle,error) {
 if ReplayOpen==nil { panic("unscripted model Open") }; return ReplayOpen(f,l,p,flags)
}
func(h *Handle) Recv(p []byte)(int,Address,error){return h.RecvFunc(p)}
func(h *Handle) RecvBatch(p []byte)(int,[]Address,error){
 if h.RecvBatchFunc==nil { panic("unscripted model RecvBatch") }
 return h.RecvBatchFunc(p)
}
// Caller storage must have BatchMax room before the receive, the receipt is
// copied only on success, and the returned slice aliases that storage. Models
// without a dedicated callback adapt the established allocating fake here.
func(h *Handle) RecvBatchInto(p []byte,a []Address)(int,[]Address,error){
 if len(a)<BatchMax { panic("model RecvBatchInto short caller storage") }
 if h.RecvBatchIntoFunc!=nil { return h.RecvBatchIntoFunc(p,a) }
 if h.RecvBatchFunc==nil { panic("unscripted model RecvBatchInto") }
 n,addrs,err:=h.RecvBatchFunc(p)
 if err!=nil { return n,nil,err }
 if len(addrs)>len(a) { panic("model RecvBatchInto receipt exceeds caller storage") }
 copy(a,addrs)
 return n,a[:len(addrs)],nil
}
// The synchronous terminal view: the fake owns the modeled lane backing and
// invokes the consumer only for a validated terminal receipt, exactly like the
// production wrapper. The consumer's views end when it returns.
func(h *Handle) RecvBatchView(n int,consume func([]byte,[]Address))(int,error){
 if h.RecvBatchViewFunc==nil { panic("unscripted model RecvBatchView") }
 return h.RecvBatchViewFunc(n,consume)
}
// The receive-bound forwarding companion: the fake owns the modeled lane
// backing and hands the consumer a one-shot capability that submits the same
// terminal batch. It never models kernel behavior beyond invoking that
// capability once; the caller's scope rules are exercised by the wrapper test.
func(h *Handle) RecvBatchViewForward(n int,consume func([]byte,[]Address,func()(int,error)))(int,error){
 if h.RecvBatchViewForwardFunc==nil { panic("unscripted model RecvBatchViewForward") }
 return h.RecvBatchViewForwardFunc(n,consume)
}
func(h *Handle) Send(p []byte,a *Address)(int,error){return h.SendFunc(p,a)}
func(h *Handle) SendBatch(p []byte,a []Address)(int,error){
 if h.SendBatchFunc==nil { panic("unscripted model SendBatch") }
 return h.SendBatchFunc(p,a)
}
func(h *Handle) ShutdownRecv()error{return h.ShutdownFunc()}
func(h *Handle) Close()error{return h.CloseFunc()}
func(h *Handle) Done()<-chan struct{}{return h.DoneChan}
var ReplayDrained=errors.New("model ERROR_NO_DATA")
func IsDrained(e error)bool{return errors.Is(e,ReplayDrained)}
const BatchMax=255
